items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: We got an opportunity to make some records... We were stuck together. No too much rehearsal. No rehearsal at all.

ctx.x: You hadn't played for six weeks?

That's right. I used to get in them snubs, you know. Used to be a fellow on Fred and 8. Well, you know, tell the truth about it. We'd handle liquor. At speakeasy times. So Rouse found out where he connected with Willie, and Willie told him just about where I stayed at. And Rouse come out and see Rouse. That's piano player. They come out there, I was sitting down in the corner. Well, Louis' room, A.M. sits right around the corner. Said, man, we got an opportunity to make some records. What's it gonna get together?…
I was just mowing there. Excuse me, I'll turn it off in a second.
